title: Vera changes the site's style in the website editor, picking only from the theme's own dials, accents and Looks, applied to the draft with section changes as one undo step

source.ref: Owner direction 2026-11-03 (implement all recommended options; keep going 17:47Z) on the Vera assistants plan, /mnt/project-files/vera-assistants-2026-11-03/REPORT.md, phase V1. Builds on LIVE-2097.

detail:
LIVE-2097 let Vera move, show, hide, duplicate and restyle sections. Owners also ask for site-wide changes ("make it softer", "use the teal"). The editor builds the theme's own style menu from the same registry the Style panel draws (the four global styles, every dial the theme declares, its named accents and its Looks) and sends it with the ask. The model may only pick ids from that menu (style, accent, look kinds); a colour, font, CSS key or invented option is refused line by line with a reason. Ticked style lines are re-checked against the theme the draft wears now and written into the draft look exactly as the Style panel writes it (the theme's own value stores nothing, a Look resets the dials first), in the same commit as any section lines: one undo step, nothing published.

Shipped: style kinds in lib/sites/editor/vera-layout.ts, the menu on the model call and server parse, combined apply in the shell.
